text:
```yaml
name: Update Open-WebUI

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-open-webui:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Remove leftover submodule
        run: |
          git submodule deinit --all
          git rm -rf .git/modules
          git clean -fdx

      - name: Clone open-webui as shallow copy
        run: git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/jrkropp/open-webui.git open-webui

      - name: Update contributor docs
        run: |
          echo "## open-webui" >> CONTRIBUTING.md
          echo "The open-webui folder contains additional tools and scripts." >> CONTRIBUTING.md

      - name: Mention automated sync in README
        run: |
          echo "### Automated Sync" >> README.md
          echo "The open-webui folder is automatically synced weekly using GitHub Actions." >> README.md

      - name: Exclude cloned repo from builds
        run: echo "open-webui/" >> .gitignore

      - name: Run tests
        run: nox -s lint tests

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: 'CONTRIBUTING.md README.md'
          commit: 'Update open-webui and documentation'

      - name: Push changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          push: true
```
